description: Main source file for a Flutter application implementing a calculator with login, signup, and dashboard screens, including UI theming, validation, and navigation logic.

classes.name: CalculatorApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter application setting up theming and initial routing.

classes.name: AppStrings
classes.description: Contains static string constants for UI labels, validation messages, and navigational texts.

classes.name: Validation
classes.description: Provides static methods for input validation, such as email and password validation.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Enum representing calculator operations: add, subtract, multiply, divide.

classes.name: GeneralErrorBanner
classes.description: Widget displaying an error message banner if the message string is non-empty.

classes.name: SurfaceCard
classes.description: A styled container with padding and border for surface grouping of UI elements.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget handling user login, including validation and navigation.

classes.name: SignUpScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget handling user sign-up, including validation and navigation.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget implementing calculator functions, operand input, operation selection, and result display.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI for each widget based on current state.

methods.name: _validateAndLogin
methods.description: Validates login inputs and navigates to dashboard if valid.

methods.name: _validateAndSignUp
methods.description: Validates sign-up inputs and navigates to dashboard if valid.

methods.name: _onOperation
methods.description: Performs selected calculator operation after validation, updates result.

methods.name: _onClear
methods.description: Resets operand inputs and result display.
